keyEvents.text: Ronald Araujo (Liverpool) is shown the yellow card.

Substitution, Liverpool. Jeremie Frimpong replaces Ronald Araujo.
Substitution, Liverpool. Rio Ngumoha replaces Lewis Koumas.
